response.sql: WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING AVG(b.amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount AS avg_budget_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, p.avg_amount / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: Event names whose budget amounts are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the overall average (each remaining event name counts once). Events sharing the same name are grouped together, with their budget lines pooled in the per-name average.
The overall average is computed over all event names (before the filter), and the same value is used for the filter, the difference, and the ratio.
